title: Agentic QE Platform - MVP - Cycle report

agents.name: Requirements agent
agents.produces: One common requirement set, story by story, for BA, PO and QE review: each requirement with its business rule, exact values, source quotes and Jira keys (versioned and traceable)

agents.name: Test design agent
agents.produces: Functional and non-functional test cases (Zephyr Scale Excel export)

agents.name: Test data agent
agents.produces: One data set per test case, generated from the data dictionary and checked against it

agents.name: Automation agent
agents.produces: Self-contained Playwright specs that load their test data

agents.name: Execution agent
agents.produces: Real Playwright run results with evidence

agents.name: Defect agent
agents.produces: Defects raised only from real failures

agents.name: Reporting agent
agents.produces: Cycle report, coverage and cycle comparison

inputsPlatformOnly: Policy and contract documents (e.g. market stay policies)
platform.capability: Guest hotel booking from search to confirmation (AQPI-1)

testing.name: EQE testing
testing.focus: The guest's business flows across the six services (search, hotel details, offers, cart, payment, reservation, confirmation and cancellation e-mails), plus the privacy, security, observability and resilience checks (AQPI-28 to AQPI-31).
testing.approach: Designs one API journey per guest business flow and the enterprise quality checks, and runs them against the six hotel services, keeping every request and response as evidence. The services have no browser screen, so no screenshots are taken.

selection.name: EQE testing
selection.focus: The guest's business flows across the six services (search, hotel details, offers, cart, payment, reservation, confirmation and cancellation e-mails), plus the privacy, security, observability and resilience checks (AQPI-28 to AQPI-31).
selection.approach: Designs one API journey per guest business flow and the enterprise quality checks, and runs them against the six hotel services, keeping every request and response as evidence. The services have no browser screen, so no screenshots are taken.

gaps.message: The hotel services have no browser screen, so the journeys run through the service APIs; screen checks such as keyboard and focus order stay manual.

reviewAgent.note: Suggestions only. The human reviewer decides every gap and conflict and approves the requirement set.

findings.title: Asked for in Jira but not mentioned in the code: AQPI-8 4.2 Sort and filter hotel results
findings.detail: 4 acceptance criteria of AQPI-8 (epic AQPI-6) have no implementation in the code: The guest can apply supported filters such as price range, amenities, hotel category, and distance when data is available. The guest can sort using approved options. Selected criteria are visible and removable. Zero results after filtering offer a reset option.
findings.suggestion: Exclude it from this cycle as a gap (a Minor gap defect is raised and the story is picked up again in the next release), or discuss with the developer and the product owner.

findings.title: Asked for in Jira but not mentioned in the code: AQPI-13 5.3 Explain and control personalization
findings.detail: 3 acceptance criteria of AQPI-13 (epic AQPI-10) have no implementation in the code: The interface identifies when offers are personalized where required. The guest can proceed without selecting ancillary products. A consent or preference change affects future eligible recommendations according to policy.
findings.suggestion: Exclude it from this cycle as a gap (a Minor gap defect is raised and the story is picked up again in the next release), or discuss with the developer and the product owner.

findings.title: Asked for in Jira but not mentioned in the code: AQPI-22 7.4 Show booking outcome
findings.detail: 3 acceptance criteria of AQPI-22 (epic AQPI-18) have no implementation in the code: Success displays confirmation identifier, hotel, stay summary, selected products, and total. A failure does not display a false confirmation. Unknown or timeout states instruct the guest not to resubmit blindly and provide a safe recovery path.
findings.suggestion: Exclude it from this cycle as a gap (a Minor gap defect is raised and the story is picked up again in the next release), or discuss with the developer and the product owner.

skills.name: Automation script conventions
skills.description: How every generated Playwright spec is shaped, named and asserted, so scripts stay reviewable and runnable cycle after cycle.

skills.name: Test cycle report
skills.description: The fixed shape of every cycle report, so two cycles can be read side by side without translation.

skills.name: Defect reporting
skills.description: What a defect must contain before it is raised, so every cycle's defects read the same and are actionable.

skills.name: Incremental load and merge rules
skills.description: How an addition is classified against the baseline and what a human must see before it merges.

skills.name: Input normalisation and provenance
skills.description: How several inputs become one requirement set, and what must be visible about where each statement came from.

skills.name: Input review before the human gate
skills.description: What the review agent checks in the project inputs and how it words its suggestions for the reviewer.

skills.name: Release criteria (Go / Conditional go / No-go)
skills.description: The parameters the cycle report applies to recommend Go, Conditional go or No-go. Edit this file, or upload a replacement, to change them without a code change.

skills.name: Test case authoring and Zephyr export shape
skills.description: One house style for every test case, so each cycle exports into Zephyr the same way.

skills.name: Test data generation from the input specs
skills.description: Every test case gets a complete, spec-conformant data set built from the data dictionary in the codebase input.

skills.name: EQE testing - enterprise end-to-end business flows
skills.description: Steers the agents to test each business flow end to end across the services, as the user experiences it.

skills.name: Traceability hand-over
skills.description: What each phase owes the next one so the chain from input to defect never breaks in any cycle.

narrative.text: Hotel booking baseline · EQE (baseline) worked from Jira initiative AQPI-1 (Jira export on GitHub), Jira epic AQPI-2, AQPI-6, AQPI-10, AQPI-14, AQPI-18, AQPI-23, AQPI-27 (Jira export on GitHub), Codebase sri465inno/uc-agentic-quality-engineering@demo/hotel-booking-platform (b212a32) (pulled live from GitHub). The reviewed requirement set holds 118 requirements. 13 test cases are designed, 8 of them automated in 7 Playwright scripts. Execution ran 8 automated cases for real: 8 passed and 0 failed (pass rate 100%). 3 defect(s) were raised from real failures: DEF-001 AQPI-8 4.2 Sort and filter hotel results: asked for in Jira but not implemented in the code; DEF-002 AQPI-13 5.3 Explain and control personalization: asked for in Jira but not implemented in the code; DEF-003 AQPI-22 7.4 Show booking outcome: asked for in Jira but not implemented in the code.
